name: antigravity-ssh-proxy
description: Easily fix connectivity issues for the Antigravity remote server. This extension ensures your remote coding tools can bypass server firewalls by securely routing Antigravity's traffic through your local computer or a designated server gateway.

commands.title: Antigravity SSH Proxy: Setup Remote Environment
Antigravity SSH Proxy: Rollback Remote Environment
Antigravity SSH Proxy: Enable Port Forwarding
Antigravity SSH Proxy: Disable Port Forwarding
Antigravity SSH Proxy: Show Status Panel
Antigravity SSH Proxy: Show Traffic Monitor

antigravity-ssh-proxy.enableLocalForward.description: Optional: route traffic through your local proxy via SSH reverse tunnel. When enabled, the extension manages ~/.ssh/config.antigravity and forwards the remote proxy port to your local machine.

antigravity-ssh-proxy.localProxyPort.description: Local proxy port on your computer (e.g., 7890 for Clash). Only used when enableLocalForwarding is true.

antigravity-ssh-proxy.forwardingRemoteHo.description: Optional SSH host patterns that should get ATP local forwarding (Host rules in ~/.ssh/config.antigravity). Leave empty to apply forwarding to all remotes (*).

antigravity-ssh-proxy.showLocalStatusBar.description: Show ATP status bar item in local (non-remote) windows. Disable to hide the local ATP button.

antigravity-ssh-proxy.remoteProxyHost.description: The host address on the remote server where the proxy is reachable. Default 127.0.0.1 for a proxy service running on the remote server itself.

antigravity-ssh-proxy.remoteProxyPort.description: The proxy gateway port on the remote server. Default is 34380 for remote-local SOCKS service setups.

antigravity-ssh-proxy.showStatusOnStartu.description: Show a status notification when connecting to a remote server. Displays proxy status and whether reload is needed.

enumDescriptions: HTTP proxy (use when your remote proxy endpoint exposes HTTP CONNECT)
SOCKS5 proxy (default, recommended for remote-local proxy services)
antigravity-ssh-proxy.proxyType.description: Proxy protocol used by the remote language server wrappers.
